# Root-owned masters seen without privileges, and the reverse.
self 230
user 0 root
user 1000 alice

proc pid=1 ppid=0 uid=0 comm=systemd
proc pid=100 comm=foot exe=/usr/bin/foot ptmx=9:1

# (a) alice's recorder on pts/2; `su` without a PTY: root's zsh shares pts/2.
#     Root sees a cinelog of another uid holding the master: nested-uid.
proc pid=200 ppid=100 comm=cinelog exe=/home/alice/.zim/modules/cinelog/bin/cinelog tty=pts/1 ptmx=5:2 start=20000
proc pid=210 ppid=200 comm=zsh tty=pts/2
proc pid=220 ppid=210 ruid=1000 euid=0 comm=su tty=pts/2 deny=fd,fdinfo
proc pid=230 ppid=220 uid=0 comm=zsh tty=pts/2
expect check tty=pts:2 start=230 euid=0 => start team nested-uid
expect holder pts=2 start=230 => pid=200 class=own-other via=ancestor uid=1000

# (b) root's TEAM recorder (fds and exe unreadable to alice) on pts/3; root runs `su alice`
#     without a PTY: alice's zsh shares pts/3. Nothing is visible; the nearest denied
#     ancestor with a known comm (su) classifies.
proc pid=300 ppid=100 uid=0 comm=cinelog tty=pts/1 ptmx=5:3 deny=fd,fdinfo,exe start=30000
proc pid=310 ppid=300 uid=0 comm=zsh tty=pts/3 deny=fd
proc pid=320 ppid=310 uid=0 comm=su tty=pts/3 deny=fd,exe
proc pid=330 ppid=320 comm=zsh tty=pts/3
expect check tty=pts:3 start=330 euid=1000 => start personal su
expect holder euid=1000 pts=3 start=330 => pid=320 via=commfallback class=privrelay uid=0

# (c) the same root recorder with alice's shell directly below it (no su in between)
proc pid=340 ppid=300 comm=zsh tty=pts/3
expect check tty=pts:3 start=340 euid=1000 => start personal nested-uid
expect holder euid=1000 pts=3 start=340 => pid=300 via=commfallback class=own-other uid=0

# (d) a denied ancestor without a known comm is not guessed at
proc pid=400 ppid=1 uid=0 comm=weird-term ptmx=3:4 deny=fd
proc pid=410 ppid=400 comm=zsh tty=pts/4
expect check tty=pts:4 start=410 euid=1000 => start personal unknown
